changes.summary: Ask Buck for any player's path through the league: every team, how he arrived and left, his salaries, points and titles, on a timeline chart. Plus the best pickups ever, by wins swung.

changes.summary: Pecking Order blurbs no longer repeat a winning or losing streak as a last-three-weeks record, and reach for a different stat instead.
Ask Buck for the biggest game between two teams: title games first, then playoff rounds and playoff-spot games, with the players who decided it. Rivalry pages show it too.

Pecking Order blurbs no longer repeat a team's streak as its last-three record, including this week's issue.
Preferences now offer every US, Canada and Mexico time zone, including BC's new year-round daylight time, and broadcast board kickoffs follow your clock.

Set Lineup: your ranking pill now sits beside each player's position instead of covering the kickoff time, and the Starters header names which board it is.
Homepage breaking news: an injury now leads your hero only if the player is on your team or is a top-5 star at his position.
Homepage breaking news comes to the AFL: a fresh trade, or an injury to your own player or a top-5 star, now leads your hero.
